chapters.title: Welcome to Bash 🐚
chapters.description: Discover the magic of the terminal! Learn what Bash is, fire your first commands, write a simple script, and make it executable.

chapters.title: Navigating the Filesystem 📂
chapters.description: Master cd, ls, mkdir, and more. Cruise through directories like a true shell pilot.

chapters.title: Variables & User Input 🧾
chapters.description: Store data and interact with users. Learn about variables, read, and environment variables.

chapters.title: Conditional Decisions 🔀
chapters.description: Let your scripts think! if, else, test, and case will help you branch like a pro.

chapters.title: Looping Like a Pro 🔄
chapters.description: Repeat tasks effortlessly with for, while, and until loops. Automate repetitive jobs!

chapters.title: Functions & Modular Code 🧩
chapters.description: Package reusable logic into functions. Write clean, maintainable scripts.

chapters.title: Files & String Manipulation 📄
chapters.description: Read, write, cut, and transform text files. Bash is a text‑processing beast!

chapters.title: Command Substitution & Arrays 🧮
chapters.description: Capture command output and manage lists. Unlock next‑level scripting power.

chapters.title: Automating with Cron & At ⏰
chapters.description: Schedule scripts to run automatically. Become the master of time!

chapters.title: Pipelines & Redirection 🌊
chapters.description: Connect commands elegantly. Stream data through pipes and redirect like a wizard.

chapters.title: Regular Expressions & grep 📝
chapters.description: Find patterns like a bloodhound. Master regex basics and grep's secrets.

chapters.title: Mastering sed & awk 🥷
chapters.description: Stream‑edit and slice text with surgical precision. The ultimate processing duo.

chapters.title: Error Handling & Debugging 🐛
chapters.description: Build resilient scripts. Catch errors, use exit codes, and squash bugs with set -x.

chapters.title: Security & Best Practices 🔒
chapters.description: Write safe, robust code. Quoting, permissions, and defensive patterns keep you secure.

chapters.title: Capstone Mastery 🏆
chapters.description: Apply everything in a real‑world automation project. Prove your Bash‑fu!
